# mimecast_profile_group (Resource)

Manage a Mimecast Cloud Gateway profile group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_profile_group" "engineering" {
  description = "tf-example-engineering"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Profile group description.

### Optional

- `parent_id` (String) Parent group ID. Mimecast uses root when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `group_count` (Number) Number of child groups.
- `id` (String) Profile group ID.
- `source` (String) Group source, such as `cloud` or `ldap`.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users in the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_profile_group.engineering group-id
```
